data.source: UK Department for Transport STATS19 road safety data

limits: This is an estimate for a collision that has already been reported. It is not a pre-collision risk score.
Fatal collisions are rare (1.47%). The model finds about 40% of them, and about 93% of the collisions it calls Fatal are false alarms.
Blank optional fields are filled with the most common value from the training data.
The Fatal weight of 1.5 was tuned on validation data for a model trained on the training split. The final model was refit on train and validation without re-tuning.
The model uses recorded conditions. It does not explain causes.
The data covers Great Britain only. Northern Ireland is not included.
